claims.evidence: DIA-NN logs: --var-mod UniMod:35,M; --var-mod UniMod:1,*n (Benchmark2/panel/GFs; Benchmark1 log has only --mod Acetyl (N-term) declaration and its HpH MaxQuant library carries N-terminal acetylation, paper lists it for all searches); --var-mod UniMod:21,STY; "Cysteine carbamidomethylation enabled as a fixed modification" (--unimod4) or MaxQuant libraries searched with fixed carbamidomethylation; --channels SILAC,H,KR,8.014199:10.008269 = K+8.0142 (13C6 15N2, UNIMOD:259) and R+10.0083 (13C6 15N4, UNIMOD:267). Labels set MT=Variable per campaign rule 11.
Every annotated run was searched with DIA-NN channels L (K0,R0) and H (K8,R10).

No --mass-acc / --mass-acc-ms1 in any command line; every log says "DIA-NN will optimise the mass accuracy automatically using the first run in the experiment". Benchmark1, Benchmark2 and panel logs carry only per-run "Recommended MS1 mass accuracy setting" values (~9-15 ppm). The HCT116GFs SPIED log has "[0:21] Cannot perform MS1 mass calibration, too few confidently identified precursors" / "[0:21] Using MS1 mass accuracy: 20 ppm" / "[0:21] Using mass accuracy: 20 ppm", followed by "[1:04] Optimised mass accuracy: 5.22028 ppm": 20 ppm is the calibration fallback of the first pass of auto-optimisation, not the search setting, and the MS1 value applied after optimisation is not logged. Hence not available in all rows.
